integrity: The exact identities are proved algebraically; a standalone exact enumeration checks 86 finite coefficients as corroboration, not as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Independent uniform fixed-size outgoing subsets; no with-replacement, preferential, correlated-row, or complete-joint-law extension claimed. Historical priority for some k=1 random-mapping consequences remains uncertain due to incomplete access to older papers.
title: Opposite signed reciprocity–indegree covariance laws with and without self-loops
